title: 必须
title_en: Talking about to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily
context: You chat about to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily.
context_en: You chat about to have to; must; compulsory; necessarily.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 如果需要延期提交論文，必須提前向老師提出請求。
turns.hanzi: 如果需要延期提交論文，必須提前向老師提出請求。
turns.pinyin: rú guǒ xū yào yán qī tí jiāo lùn wén ， bì xū tí qián xiàng lǎo shī tí chū qǐng qiú 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄖㄨˊ ㄍㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄧㄢˊ ㄑㄧ ㄊㄧˊ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄌㄨㄣˋ ㄨㄣˊ ， ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄊㄧˊ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄒㄧㄤˋ ㄌㄠˇ ㄕ ㄊㄧˊ ㄔㄨ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄑㄧㄡˊ 。
turns.romanization: Rúguǒ xūyào yánqī tíjiāo lùnwén, bìxū tíqián xiàng lǎoshī tíchū qǐngqiú.
turns.translation: If you need to delay submitting the paper, you must make a request to the teacher in advance.
turns.translation_en: If you need to delay submitting the paper, you must make a request to the teacher in advance.
turns.translation_id: Jika Anda perlu menunda penyerahan makalah, Anda harus mengajukan permintaan kepada guru terlebih dahulu.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 要解決這個問題，必須從根本上改變管理方式。
turns.hanzi: 要解決這個問題，必須從根本上改變管理方式。
turns.pinyin: yào jiě jué zhè gè wèn tí ， bì xū cóng gēn běn shàng gǎi biàn guǎn lǐ fāng shì 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧㄝˇ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄓㄜˋ ㄍㄜˋ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ ， ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄘㄨㄥˊ ㄍㄣ ㄅㄣˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄍㄞˇ ㄅㄧㄢˋ ㄍㄨㄢˇ ㄌㄧˇ ㄈㄤ ㄕˋ 。
turns.romanization: Yào jiějué zhège wèntí, bìxū cóng gēnběn shang gǎibiàn guǎnlǐ fāngshì.
turns.translation: To solve this problem, the management method must be changed at a fundamental level.
turns.translation_en: To solve this problem, the management method must be changed at a fundamental level.
turns.translation_id: Untuk mengatasi masalah ini, metode pengelolaan harus diubah secara mendasar.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 公司在做決定時，必須保護員工的合法利益。
turns.hanzi: 公司在做決定時，必須保護員工的合法利益。
turns.pinyin: gōng sī zài zuò jué dìng shí ， bì xū bǎo hù yuán gōng de hé fǎ lì yì 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄗㄞˋ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄐㄩㄝˊ ㄉㄧㄥˋ ㄕˊ ， ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄅㄠˇ ㄏㄨˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄏㄜˊ ㄈㄚˇ ㄌㄧˋ ㄧˋ 。
turns.romanization: Gōngsī zài zuò juédìng shí, bìxū bǎohù yuángōng de héfǎ lìyì.
turns.translation: When making decisions, the company must protect employees’ lawful interests.
turns.translation_en: When making decisions, the company must protect employees’ lawful interests.
turns.translation_id: Saat mengambil keputusan, perusahaan harus melindungi kepentingan sah karyawan.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 我們的時間有限，必須先處理最重要的問題。
turns.hanzi: 我們的時間有限，必須先處理最重要的問題。
turns.pinyin: wǒ men de shí jiān yǒu xiàn ， bì xū xiān chù lǐ zuì zhòng yào de wèn tí 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄨㄛˇ ㄇㄣ˙ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄧㄡˇ ㄒㄧㄢˋ ， ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄒㄧㄢ ㄔㄨˋ ㄌㄧˇ ㄗㄨㄟˋ ㄓㄨㄥˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄨㄣˋ ㄊㄧˊ 。
turns.romanization: Wǒmen de shíjiān yǒuxiàn, bìxū xiān chǔlǐ zuì zhòngyào de wèntí.
turns.translation: Our time is limited, so we must deal with the most important issue first.
turns.translation_en: Our time is limited, so we must deal with the most important issue first.
turns.translation_id: Waktu kita terbatas, jadi kita harus menyelesaikan masalah yang paling penting terlebih dahulu.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 這份申請必須由本人簽字，不能請別人代簽。
turns.hanzi: 這份申請必須由本人簽字，不能請別人代簽。
turns.pinyin: zhè fèn shēn qǐng bì xū yóu běn rén qiān zì ， bù néng qǐng bié rén dài qiān 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄕㄣ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄡˊ ㄅㄣˇ ㄖㄣˊ ㄑㄧㄢ ㄗˋ ， ㄅㄨˋ ㄋㄥˊ ㄑㄧㄥˇ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄖㄣˊ ㄉㄞˋ ㄑㄧㄢ 。
turns.romanization: Zhè fèn shēnqǐng bìxū yóu běnrén qiānzì, bù néng qǐng biérén dài qiān.
turns.translation: This application must be signed by the person themself; someone else cannot sign on their behalf.
turns.translation_en: This application must be signed by the person themself; someone else cannot sign on their behalf.
turns.translation_id: Permohonan ini harus ditandatangani oleh orang tersebut sendiri; orang lain tidak dapat menandatangani atas nama mereka.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 公司必須證明所有收入都來自合法渠道。
turns.hanzi: 公司必須證明所有收入都來自合法渠道。
turns.pinyin: gōng sī bì xū zhèng míng suǒ yǒu shōu rù dōu lái zì hé fǎ qú dào 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄍㄨㄥ ㄙ ㄅㄧˋ ㄒㄩ ㄓㄥˋ ㄇㄧㄥˊ ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄧㄡˇ ㄕㄡ ㄖㄨˋ ㄉㄡ ㄌㄞˊ ㄗˋ ㄏㄜˊ ㄈㄚˇ ㄑㄩˊ ㄉㄠˋ 。
turns.romanization: Gōngsī bìxū zhèngmíng suǒyǒu shōurù dōu láizì héfǎ qúdào.
turns.translation: The company must prove that all its income comes from legal channels.
turns.translation_en: The company must prove that all its income comes from legal channels.
turns.translation_id: Perusahaan tersebut harus membuktikan bahwa seluruh pendapatannya berasal dari sumber yang sah.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 飛機進入跑道前，乘客都被要求繫好安全帶。
turns.hanzi: 飛機進入跑道前，乘客都被要求繫好安全帶。
turns.pinyin: fēi jī jìn rù pǎo dào qián ， chéng kè dōu bèi yāo qiú xì hǎo ān quán dài 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄈㄟ ㄐㄧ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄖㄨˋ ㄆㄠˇ ㄉㄠˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ， ㄔㄥˊ ㄎㄜˋ ㄉㄡ ㄅㄟˋ ㄧㄠ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄒㄧˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄉㄞˋ 。
turns.romanization: Fēijī jìnrù pǎodào qián, chéngkè dōu bèi yāoqiú jì hǎo ānquán dài.
turns.translation: Before the plane entered the runway, all passengers were asked to fasten their seat belts.
turns.translation_en: Before the plane entered the runway, all passengers were asked to fasten their seat belts.
turns.translation_id: Sebelum pesawat memasuki landasan, seluruh penumpang diminta mengencangkan sabuk pengaman.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 乘務員提醒乘客繫好安全帶，飛機馬上就要起飛了。
turns.hanzi: 乘務員提醒乘客繫好安全帶，飛機馬上就要起飛了。
turns.pinyin: chéng wù yuán tí xǐng chéng kè xì hǎo ān quán dài ， fēi jī mǎ shàng jiù yào qǐ fēi le 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄔㄥˊ ㄨˋ ㄩㄢˊ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄔㄥˊ ㄎㄜˋ ㄒㄧˋ ㄏㄠˇ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄉㄞˋ ， ㄈㄟ ㄐㄧ ㄇㄚˇ ㄕㄤˋ ㄐㄧㄡˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄑㄧˇ ㄈㄟ ㄌㄜ˙ 。
turns.romanization: Chéngwùyuán tíxǐng chéngkè jì hǎo ānquándài, fēijī mǎshàng jiù yào qǐfēi le.
turns.translation: The crew member reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts, as the plane was about to take off.
turns.translation_en: The crew member reminded passengers to fasten their seatbelts, as the plane was about to take off.
turns.translation_id: Awak pesawat mengingatkan penumpang untuk mengencangkan sabuk pengaman, karena pesawat hendak lepas landas.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 學校附近一帶交通複雜，放學時需要特別注意安全。
turns.hanzi: 學校附近一帶交通複雜，放學時需要特別注意安全。
turns.pinyin: xué xiào fù jìn yī dài jiāo tōng fù zá ， fàng xué shí xū yào tè bié zhù yì ān quán 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄒㄧㄠˋ ㄈㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄧ ㄉㄞˋ ㄐㄧㄠ ㄊㄨㄥ ㄈㄨˋ ㄗㄚˊ ， ㄈㄤˋ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄕˊ ㄒㄩ ㄧㄠˋ ㄊㄜˋ ㄅㄧㄝˊ ㄓㄨˋ ㄧˋ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ 。
turns.romanization: Xuéxiào fùjìn yídài jiāotōng fùzá, fàngxué shí xūyào tèbié zhùyì ānquán.
turns.translation: The area around the school has complicated traffic, so extra attention to safety is needed after school.
turns.translation_en: The area around the school has complicated traffic, so extra attention to safety is needed after school.
turns.translation_id: Kawasan sekitar sekolah memiliki lalu lintas yang rumit, sehingga diperlukan perhatian ekstra terhadap keselamatan sepulang sekolah.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 這些安全常識雖然簡單，但遇到危險時非常有用。
turns.hanzi: 這些安全常識雖然簡單，但遇到危險時非常有用。
turns.pinyin: zhè xiē ān quán cháng shí suī rán jiǎn dān ， dàn yù dào wēi xiǎn shí fēi cháng yǒu yòng 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄒㄧㄝ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ ㄔㄤˊ ㄕˊ ㄙㄨㄟ ㄖㄢˊ ㄐㄧㄢˇ ㄉㄢ ， ㄉㄢˋ ㄩˋ ㄉㄠˋ ㄨㄟ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ㄕˊ ㄈㄟ ㄔㄤˊ ㄧㄡˇ ㄩㄥˋ 。
turns.romanization: Zhèxiē ānquán chángshí suīrán jiǎndān, dàn yùdào wēixiǎn shí fēicháng yǒuyòng.
turns.translation: Although these safety tips are simple, they are very useful when danger occurs.
turns.translation_en: Although these safety tips are simple, they are very useful when danger occurs.
turns.translation_id: Meskipun tips keselamatan ini sederhana, namun sangat berguna ketika terjadi bahaya.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 孩子站在窗臺旁看雪，家長一直提醒他注意安全。
turns.hanzi: 孩子站在窗臺旁看雪，家長一直提醒他注意安全。
turns.pinyin: hái zi zhàn zài chuāng tái páng kàn xuě ， jiā zhǎng yì zhí tí xǐng tā zhù yì ān quán 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄞˊ ㄗ˙ ㄓㄢˋ ㄗㄞˋ ㄔㄨㄤ ㄊㄞˊ ㄆㄤˊ ㄎㄢˋ ㄒㄩㄝˇ ， ㄐㄧㄚ ㄓㄤˇ ㄧˋ ㄓˊ ㄊㄧˊ ㄒㄧㄥˇ ㄊㄚ ㄓㄨˋ ㄧˋ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ 。
turns.romanization: Háizi zhàn zài chuāngtái páng kàn xuě, jiāzhǎng yìzhí tíxǐng tā zhùyì ānquán.
turns.translation: The child stood beside the windowsill watching the snow, while the parent kept reminding him to stay safe.
turns.translation_en: The child stood beside the windowsill watching the snow, while the parent kept reminding him to stay safe.
turns.translation_id: Anak itu berdiri di samping ambang jendela sambil mengamati salju, sementara orang tuanya terus mengingatkannya untuk tetap aman.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 你遲到幾分鐘不要緊，關鍵是路上要注意安全。
turns.hanzi: 你遲到幾分鐘不要緊，關鍵是路上要注意安全。
turns.pinyin: nǐ chí dào jǐ fēn zhōng bú yào jǐn ， guān jiàn shì lù shàng yào zhù yì ān quán 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄋㄧˇ ㄔˊ ㄉㄠˋ ㄐㄧˇ ㄈㄣ ㄓㄨㄥ ㄅㄨˊ ㄧㄠˋ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ， ㄍㄨㄢ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄕˋ ㄌㄨˋ ㄕㄤˋ ㄧㄠˋ ㄓㄨˋ ㄧˋ ㄢ ㄑㄩㄢˊ 。
turns.romanization: Nǐ chídào jǐ fēnzhōng búyàojǐn, guānjiàn shì lùshang yào zhùyì ānquán.
turns.translation: It does not matter if you are a few minutes late; the key thing is to stay safe on the way.
turns.translation_en: It does not matter if you are a few minutes late; the key thing is to stay safe on the way.

title: 报告
title_en: Talking about to make a report / report
context: You chat about to make a report / report.
context_en: You chat about to make a report / report.
context_id: Kamu mengobrol tentang untuk membuat laporan.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 這份報告不僅指出風險，也提出了許多正面的建議。
turns.hanzi: 這份報告不僅指出風險，也提出了許多正面的建議。
turns.pinyin: zhè fèn bào gào bù jǐn zhǐ chū fēng xiǎn ， yě tí chū le xǔ duō zhèng miàn de jiàn yì 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄈㄣˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄐㄧㄣˇ ㄓˇ ㄔㄨ ㄈㄥ ㄒㄧㄢˇ ， ㄧㄝˇ ㄊㄧˊ ㄔㄨ ㄌㄜ˙ ㄒㄩˇ ㄉㄨㄛ ㄓㄥˋ ㄇㄧㄢˋ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄧˋ 。
turns.romanization: Zhè fèn bàogào bùjǐn zhǐchū fēngxiǎn, yě tíchū le xǔduō zhèngmiàn de jiànyì.
turns.translation: This report not only points out risks but also offers many positive suggestions.
turns.translation_en: This report not only points out risks but also offers many positive suggestions.
turns.translation_id: Laporan ini tidak hanya menunjukkan risiko tetapi juga memberikan banyak saran positif.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 他居然能在如此短的時間內完成報告，真了不起。
turns.hanzi: 他居然能在如此短的時間內完成報告，真了不起。
turns.pinyin: tā jū rán néng zài rú cǐ duǎn de shí jiān nèi wán chéng bào gào ， zhēn liǎo bù qǐ 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄊㄚ ㄐㄩ ㄖㄢˊ ㄋㄥˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄖㄨˊ ㄘˇ ㄉㄨㄢˇ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢ ㄋㄟˋ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ， ㄓㄣ ㄌㄧㄠˇ ㄅㄨˋ ㄑㄧˇ 。
turns.romanization: Tā jūrán néng zài rúcǐ duǎn de shíjiān nèi wánchéng bàogào, zhēn liǎobuqǐ.
turns.translation: He unexpectedly managed to finish the report in such a short time; that is really amazing.
turns.translation_en: He unexpectedly managed to finish the report in such a short time; that is really amazing.
turns.translation_id: Dia secara tak terduga berhasil menyelesaikan laporannya dalam waktu sesingkat itu; itu sungguh menakjubkan.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 會議結束前，每個部門都要報告本週的工作進展。
turns.hanzi: 會議結束前，每個部門都要報告本週的工作進展。
turns.pinyin: huì yì jié shù qián ， měi gè bù mén dōu yào bào gào běn zhōu de gōng zuò jìn zhǎn 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄏㄨㄟˋ ㄧˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄕㄨˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ， ㄇㄟˇ ㄍㄜˋ ㄅㄨˋ ㄇㄣˊ ㄉㄡ ㄧㄠˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ ㄅㄣˇ ㄓㄡ ㄉㄜ˙ ㄍㄨㄥ ㄗㄨㄛˋ ㄐㄧㄣˋ ㄓㄢˇ 。
turns.romanization: Huìyì jiéshù qián, měi gè bùmén dōu yào bàogào běn zhōu de gōngzuò jìnzhǎn.
turns.translation: Before the meeting ends, every department must report this week’s work progress.
turns.translation_en: Before the meeting ends, every department must report this week’s work progress.
turns.translation_id: Sebelum rapat berakhir, setiap departemen harus melaporkan kemajuan pekerjaan minggu ini.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: 這所學院要求學員在結業前完成一份實踐報告。
turns.hanzi: 這所學院要求學員在結業前完成一份實踐報告。
turns.pinyin: zhè suǒ xué yuàn yāo qiú xué yuán zài jié yè qián wán chéng yī fèn shí jiàn bào gào 。
turns.zhuyin: ㄓㄜˋ ㄙㄨㄛˇ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄩㄢˋ ㄧㄠ ㄑㄧㄡˊ ㄒㄩㄝˊ ㄩㄢˊ ㄗㄞˋ ㄐㄧㄝˊ ㄧㄝˋ ㄑㄧㄢˊ ㄨㄢˊ ㄔㄥˊ ㄧ ㄈㄣˋ ㄕˊ ㄐㄧㄢˋ ㄅㄠˋ ㄍㄠˋ 。
turns.romanization: Zhè suǒ xuéyuàn yāoqiú xuéyuán zài jiéyè qián wánchéng yí fèn shíjiàn bàogào.
turns.translation: This institute requires students to complete a practical report before graduation.
turns.translation_en: This institute requires students to complete a practical report before graduation.
turns.translation_id: Lembaga ini mewajibkan mahasiswanya untuk menyelesaikan laporan praktikum sebelum lulus.

turns.speaker: tutor
turns.text: 寫報告以前，你可以先參考去年的數據和結論。
turns.hanzi: 寫報告以前，你可以先參考去年的數據和結論。
turns.pinyin: xiě bào gào yǐ qián ， nǐ kě yǐ xiān cān kǎo qù nián de shù jù hé jié lùn 。

turns.translation: Before writing the report, you can first refer to last year’s data and conclusions.
turns.translation_en: Before writing the report, you can first refer to last year’s data and conclusions.
